newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan oil sector shares stage rebound.
newsitem.headline: Japan oil sector shares stage rebound.

text.p: Japanese oil sector shares rose in Tuesday morning trade, rebounding from a recent decline as investors are starting to think that the sector has been oversold, brokers said.
At midday, Nippon Oil Co was up 21 yen at 501. Mitsubishi Oil Co Ltd rose 28 yen to 530. Tonen Corp rose 70 yen to 1,220. Showa Shell Sekiyu KK was 71 yen higher at 938.

"The market fell sharply on Monday and in addition to the buy-backs, a feeling that shares in the sector have fallen to bargain levels is causing some buying," a broker at a second-tier brokerage said.
